place.en: The Si · Before the stone door

setup.zh: 冬月初一，泗水退潮，秘境开门。领了灵石，往前十步，照旧是那只描金小木匣。马小宝眼皮也不抬：「沈小满。两块。」
setup.en: The first of the eleventh month: the Si ebbs and the hidden realm opens. Stones drawn, ten steps on, the same little gilt box. Ma Xiaobao doesn't lift his eyelids: "Shen Xiaoman. Two."

recap.zh: 冬月初一，沉鼎秘境开了。阿禾把她背熟了的地图借给你——利息，两块。
recap.en: The first of the eleventh month, the Chending hidden realm opened. Ah He lent you the map she'd learned by heart — interest: two.

en: The first of the eleventh month; the Si ebbs.

story.zh:
冬月初一，天还没亮，外门执事房门口照例排起了长龙。

周衡坐在榆木桌子后面，面前摊着那本厚得能当枕头的账簿，叫一个名字，发一回灵石，每人三块，一块不多，一块不少。他今日的神色和往常不大一样，发一个，便要抬起头来叮嘱一句：「秘境里头，保命要紧。灵草丢了，明年还长；人丢了，账上不好记。」有个新来的弟子问他：「周师兄，秘境里死过人么？」周衡翻了翻账簿，翻到最后几页，那几页的纸比别的黄，上面记着几个名字，名字底下画着一道红杠。他看了一会儿，把账簿合上了，道：「有前途。」那弟子没听懂，捧着灵石走了。

领到了灵石，往前走不上十步，照旧是那张桌子，照旧是那只描金小木匣，匣上照旧贴着红纸，写着「公中」。只是马小宝身后的那两个跟班，今日换成了三个，一个个抱着胳膊，站得跟门神一般。马小宝拿指节笃笃地敲着木匣，眼皮也不抬：「沈小满。两块。」
story.en:
The first of the eleventh month. Before dawn, as usual, a long queue formed outside the stewards' office of the outer court.

Zhou Heng sat behind the elm table, the ledger thick enough for a pillow open before him; he called a name and handed out stones, three apiece, not one more, not one fewer. Today he looked different from usual: with every one he handed out he looked up and warned, "In the hidden realm, your life comes first. Lose a herb, it grows again next year; lose a man, the books won't balance." A new disciple asked him, "Brother Zhou, has anyone died in the hidden realm?" Zhou Heng leafed through the ledger to its last pages — yellower than the rest, a few names written there, a red stroke under each. He looked at them a while, closed the ledger, and said, "Promising." The disciple didn't understand, and went off holding his stones.

Ten steps on from the stones, the same table as ever, the same little gilt box, the same red paper on it: COMMON FUND. Only the two followers behind Ma Xiaobao were three today, arms folded, standing like door gods. Ma Xiaobao rapped the box with a knuckle, not lifting his eyelids: "Shen Xiaoman. Two."

exits.means: pays two stones to Ma Xiaobao's common fund

refuse.en: You haven't two spirit stones on you.

what.zh: 冬月初一，秘境门口，公中：两块灵石。
what.en: The first of the eleventh month, at the hidden realm's door, the common fund: two spirit stones.

story.zh:
排在小满前头的孙二狗交的是一块。小满便道：「小宝哥，孙师兄交的是一块。」马小宝道：「他是他，你是你。」小满道：「那是为什么？」马小宝这才抬起眼皮，冲他咧嘴一笑，道：「因为你收了个畜生。畜生也要吃饭。」

小满心想，小狰吃的是药园的残株，残株是周衡记在账上给他的，跟公中半文钱的干系也没有。可他没有说。他数出两块灵石，放进匣子里，道：「小宝哥说得对。畜生也要吃饭。」马小宝没听出这话里有什么不对，很满意地挥了挥手。

小满往前走了十步，停下来，从怀里摸出那个红糖包纸订的小本子，舔了舔笔尖，写道：

**冬月初一。公中。灵石两块。马小宝。因由：畜生也要吃饭。**

写到「畜生」两个字，他笔尖停了一停，想了一想，没有写明是哪一个畜生。

执事房外头那片空场上，一早便摆开了七八张桌子，卖的是秘境的地图，一块灵石一张。小满在桌子前头站了很久，把那张地图从头看到尾，没有买。

身后忽然有人拍他肩膀。他回头一看，是阿禾。她穿着那件大一号的灰袍，袖子挽了三道，鼻头冻得通红，手里捏着一张地图，比桌上卖的那些还要新，还要密。

阿禾道：「你的地图呢？」小满道：「没有。」阿禾道：「你不买？」小满道：「不买。」阿禾道：「为什么？」小满想了想，道：「一块灵石，买一张写着『无』的纸，不划算。」

阿禾看了他一会儿，把她手里那张地图塞给了他，道：「借你。」小满一愣：「那你呢？」阿禾面无表情地道：「我背下来了。」小满道：「……什么时候？」阿禾道：「昨天夜里。他们卖一块，我借来看一夜，给了半块。」小满道：「半块？」阿禾道：「我说我只看一半。」小满道：「你看了多少？」阿禾道：「全看了。」

小满张着嘴，半天合不上。阿禾又道：「利息，两块。」小满道：「你借来才花了半块！」阿禾道：「我背下来，花了一夜。一夜的灯油，外门每人每月只有半根蜡烛。」她掰着指头，「蜡烛，辛苦，风险，都要算。」小满道：「……你到底借给多少人过？」阿禾道：「就你一个。」小满道：「那为什么利息这么高？」阿禾道：「就你一个，所以利息高。」

她说完转身便走，走了两步，又回过头来，补了一句：「往右走。右边人多。人多，死不了。」

小满捏着那张地图，没有说话。
story.en:
Sun Ergou, ahead of Xiaoman in the line, paid one. So Xiaoman said, "Brother Xiaobao, Brother Sun paid one."

"He's him, you're you," said Ma Xiaobao.

"Why's that?"

Only now did Ma Xiaobao lift his eyelids; he grinned at him. "Because you've got an animal. Animals have to eat too."

Xiaoman thought: Little Zheng eats the herb garden's culls, and the culls are what Zhou Heng enters in the ledger for him — nothing to do with the common fund, not half a copper. But he didn't say so. He counted out two stones, put them in the box, and said, "Brother Xiaobao is right. Animals have to eat too." Ma Xiaobao heard nothing wrong in that, and waved him on, very satisfied.

Xiaoman walked ten steps, stopped, took out the little notebook sewn from red-sugar wrapping paper, licked the brush, and wrote:

**First day, eleventh month. Common fund. Two spirit stones. Ma Xiaobao. Reason: animals have to eat too.**

At the word "animals" his brush paused; he thought a moment, and didn't write which animal he meant.

On the open ground outside the stewards' office seven or eight tables had been set up since early morning, selling maps of the hidden realm, one stone apiece. Xiaoman stood a long time at a table and read a map from end to end, and didn't buy.

Someone tapped him on the shoulder. He turned: Ah He. She wore that robe a size too big, sleeves rolled three times, nose frozen red, and in her hand a map newer and denser than any on the tables.

"Where's your map?" said Ah He. "Haven't got one," said Xiaoman. "Not buying?" "Not buying." "Why not?" Xiaoman thought, and said, "A stone for a sheet of paper that says 'none' — bad bargain."

Ah He looked at him a while, then pushed her map into his hands. "Lend you." Xiaoman stared. "What about you?" Ah He said without expression, "I learned it by heart." "…When?" "Last night. They sell for one; I borrowed one to look at for a night, gave half." "Half?" "I said I'd only look at half." "How much did you look at?" "All of it."

Xiaoman's mouth hung open a long time. Ah He said, "Interest: two." "You only paid half to borrow it!" "It cost me a night to learn. A night's lamp oil — the outer court gives each of us half a candle a month." She counted on her fingers. "Candle, labour, risk — it all counts." "…How many people have you lent to?" "Only you." "Then why's the interest so high?" "Only you. That's why."

She turned and went, took two steps, looked back and added, "Go right. More people on the right. More people, nobody dies."

Xiaoman held the map and said nothing.

exits.means: refuses to pay the common fund

what.zh: 冬月初一，秘境门口：你没交公中。他笑着说，秘境里死个把人，可不稀奇。
what.en: The first of the eleventh month, at the hidden realm's door: you didn't pay the common fund. He smiled: people die in the hidden realm all the time.

story.en:
Xiaoman closed his hand on his stones. "Brother Xiaobao, the common fund on the first is one."

Ma Xiaobao didn't lift his eyelids; he only rapped the box twice more with a knuckle and smiled: "In the hidden realm, people die now and then. Nothing strange in it."

Xiaoman didn't answer that. He walked off with his stones in his fist. Ten steps on he took out the little notebook sewn from red-sugar wrapping paper and wrote: **First day, eleventh month. Common fund. Not paid. Ma Xiaobao: in the hidden realm, people die now and then.**
